searches.title: Searches
searches.description: Products or keywords, one per line, as you would type them on the store website, e.g. milk, tim tams, "olive oil", nappies.

maxProductsPerSearch.title: Max products per search, per store
maxProductsPerSearch.description: Woolworths pages hold 36 products and Coles pages 48; more reads further pages.

onlySpecials.title: Only specials
onlySpecials.description: Keep only products on special, half price or with a was-price. Other rows are not charged.

compareStores.title: Match products across stores
compareStores.description: When both stores are selected, pair the same branded product (same pack size, near-identical name) and add otherStore, cheaperAt and priceDifference. Store brands (Woolworths, Coles, Macro...) are never paired.
